extracted.name: Lemon Bundt Cake
extracted.description: Lemon instant pudding and lemon-lime soda make this moist, flavorful lemon Bundt cake a quick, crowd-pleasing dessert for any occasion.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.4 ounce) package instant lemon pudding mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan.
Combine cake mix and pudding mix in a large bowl. Stir in oil, then beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in lemon-lime soda until batter is smooth and well combined.

Pour batter into the prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 45 to 50 minutes. Let cake cool in the pan before removing. Cool completely before serving.
